Hi Vera! I checked my notes for LEDGERLIB-107. In the design review, it was agreed that the sequence restarts every calendar year: when `last_number` belongs to an earlier year than `year`, the next number should be CN-<year>-0001 (e.g., after 'CN-2024-0173', the first credit note of 2025 is 'CN-2025-0001').

Hi Lena! I've just implemented extract_invoice_refs, it should be in the repo now. Regarding reconcile_payments: the design review agreed that amount-only matches (rule 3) are made only when exactly one unmatched invoice has that amount. If two or more share the amount, the line stays unmatched for manual review.
